tables.Description: Announced the Archer Queen.
Added the Archer Queen, with 30 levels.
Added levels 31 to 40 Archer Queen.
Added the Royal Cloak ability.
Reduced hero regeneration times greatly at all levels.
Hero icons now show hero ability status in replays.
Hero ability icons now show remaining hitpoints and start flashing when low.
Added levels 41 to 45 Archer Queen.
Added levels 46 to 50 Archer Queen.
Added levels 51 to 60 Archer Queen.
Converted the Archer Queen from 2D to 3D.
Added levels 61 to 65 Archer Queen.
Added levels 66 to 70 Archer Queen.

New Hero Skin selection screen that is much easier to select which skin you want to apply to your Hero. Archer Queen now displays in her selected skin under the Player Profile tab. When acquiring a new skin, the UI to select the skin will automatically open. Some selected skins will be able to be purchased outside of the Gold Pass. Fixed a bug where the Archer Queen received double health recovery when her ability is used both automatically and manually at the same time. Show purple Hero level icons properly in attack confirm screen if Hero Potion is active.
Added levels 71 to 75 Archer Queen.
Heroes now automatically heal when the player's base is raided. Removed guard toggle.
Fixed skin names not changing when changing Hero with the arrows (in the "Change Skin" menus).

At the end of a battle, if the Archer Queen's ability remains unused, the Hero will heal the amount of health they would normally recover from using their ability. This will help reduce the Hero's downtime, allowing them to be ready much sooner. A new Cosmetics tab has been added to the in-game shop where you can browse and purchase any permanently available cosmetics such as Hero Skins when they become available for Gems. A "View Skin" option has been added when visiting. Skin animations are more elaborate when viewed in the wardrobe and simpler animations in other UI elements.
Added levels 76 to 80 Archer Queen. Boosts on Archer Queen and other Heroes or Buildings are no longer cancelled when an upgrade is started and will continue to run in the background.
Added levels 81 to 85 Archer Queen.
Changed the Archer Queen's 3D model.
Added levels 86 to 90 Archer Queen.

Added levels 91 to 95 Archer Queen. Replaced the Royal Cloak ability with Hero Equipment and a health recovery stat. As a result, the Archer Queen loses damage and max health at every level, with much of the missing stats being given to his default Hero Equipment.
Added levels 96 to 100 Archer Queen. The Archer Queen is no longer unlocked by placing down her Altar , but getting level 2 Hero Hall . Her Altar is replaced by the Hero Banner obstacle.
Removed regeneration time.
Removed regeneration time in the info screen, which was still there prior to this update.
Moved levels 81 to 85 Archer Queen from Town Hall 15 to Town Hall 14.
Added levels 101 to 105 Archer Queen.
Updated Cost & Time Reductions

Added levels 106 to 110 Archer Queen. Upgrade Times Levels 71-75: 4.5d -> 4d Levels 76-80: 5d -> 4.5d Levels 81-85: 6d -> 5d Levels 86-90: 7d -> 6d Levels 91-95: 8d -> 7d Costs Level 82: 190K -> 185K Level 83: 200K -> 190K Level 84: 210K -> 195K Level 85: 220K -> 200K Level 86: 230K -> 215K Level 87: 240K -> 225K Level 88: 250K -> 235K Level 89: 260K -> 245K Level 90: 270K -> 255K

tables.Notes: Available as the first reward on the Gold Pass track.
The Warrior Queen (literally "Heroic Mulan" in Chinese) was available in Lunar New Year offers in 2020, 2021, 2022.
The Champion Queen skin was available in a special offer for the World Finals in 2021 and 2022.  In September 2024, it was purchasable in the Mini Spotlight medal event for 2,250 .
The Pixel Queen was available in a 10th Clashiversary offer in August 2022; costing $4.99 USD (or equivalent), half of the usual price for Legendary skins.
The Magic Queen was available in a special offer for the release of Town Hall 15.
The Lunar Queen was available in a special Lunar New Year offer in January 2023.
The Heart Hunter Queen was available in a special offer in February 2023 for Valentine's Day.
The Painter Queen was available in a special offer in March 2023 as part of the Color Fest event. Alternatively, it could be purchased in a bundle with the other three Painter skins for $24.99 USD.
The League Queen is permanently available in the Clan War Leagues Shop starting from the June 2023 update. It costs 2,000 .
The Future Queen skin was available in a special offer for the 11th Clashiversary in August 2023.
The Ghost Queen skin was available as a part of the Mashup Madness medal event in October 2023, where it could be bought for 4,650 .
The Gingerbread Queen skin was available in a special Clashmas offer in December 2023.
The Queen of the North skin was available in a special offer in January 2024; it cost $9.99 USD or equivalent.
The Dragon Queen skin was available in a special Lunar New Year offer in February 2024.
Available as part of the Clash with Haaland medal event in May 2024, where it could be bought for 4,650 .
Based on the WWE wrestler Rhea Ripley , as part of the Clashamania collaboration season.
Available as a reward from Hero's Journey once a cumulative total of 225 Hero levels is attained.
Based on the WWE wrestler Alexa Bliss , as part of the Search for Cena collaboration season.

raw_text: [[File:{{{Alt}}}|28px|link=]] Large Article This article currently has 66,242 bytes, and could take a long time to load, especially on low-end devices. Please proceed with caution and wait for it to load patiently. For the troop, see Archer . For the Super , Builder Base and Clan Capital troop with a similar ability which are only active upon being deployed, see Sneaky Goblin and Sneaky Archer . "Towering above all other Archers , this graceful huntress is a master of destructive force. Although her health is modest, she snipes targets from afar with her powerful X-bow . As a defender she guards the village with a vengeance." Contents 1 Summary 2 Strategies 2.1 Offensive Strategies 2.2 Defensive Strategies 3 Statistics 4 Hero Equipment 5 History 6 Hero Skins 6.1 Skin Availability 6.2 Archer Queen Skins 6.3 Archer Queen Skin Features 6.4 Notes 7 Trivia 7.1 Comparisons Summary The Archer Queen is the second Hero unlocked at Hero Hall Level 2, which requires Town Hall Level 8. She is essentially a bigger and much more powerful version of the Archer . In addition to possessing much higher damage and hitpoints, the Archer Queen also shoots 1.5 tiles farther than a normal Archer (5 tiles instead of 3.5 tiles). In her default skin, the Archer Queen otherwise appears similar to a level 3-4 or 6-7 Archer, but much larger, wields a modified X-Bow instead of a regular bow, and wears a golden crown on her head, a hunter green tunic and cloak, and a purple loincloth tied around her waist. She does not wear any footwear. The Archer Queen shoots three rapid arrows per shot. However, that is more of a visual feature, because these arrows deal damage to a single target. As a Hero, the Archer Queen can participate in both attack and defense, but will not be available to use while under upgrade. The Archer Queen will defend the village when assigned to a Hero Banner . The Archer Queen only defends her territory around her banner and will retreat if lured too far out. She does not need to be defeated for an attack to end in a 3-star. Unlike the Barbarian King, the Archer Queen can attack air units like Balloons , Dragons , or Minions , making her effective in guarding a village against players who conduct air raids. As a Hero, the Archer Queen has an ability that can be used once per battle which allows her to recover some of her health, and the amount increases at every fifth level. The Hero Equipment that she wields may add additional effects to the ability or a unique passive effect, on top of various passive stats increase. When unlocked, she starts with the Archer Puppet and Invisibility Vial. The Archer Puppet allows the Archer Queen to summon a large number of invisible Archers and an increase health recovery. The level of the Archers matches the level researched by the player. It gives a passive increase to damage. The Invisibility Vial turns the Archer Queen invisible and gives her significantly increased damage for the duration. It gives a passive increase to maximum health. Upgrading the Blacksmith to level 2 and 5 unlocks the Giant Arrow and Healer Puppet respectively. The Giant Arrow launches a large arrow that travels the whole village, dealing damage on the way. It gives a passive increase to damage and max health. The Healer Puppet summons Healers, with the number of Healers is dependent on the level of this Equipment. It gives a passive increase to her maximum health and grants her self healing. Additionally, there are Epic rarity Hero Equipment which can be purchased with event medals during certain events or gems with the Trader . The Frozen Arrow passively makes her attacks slow down defenses, defending Heroes and troops. It gives a passive increase to damage. The Magic Mirror summons clone(s) of herself, provides a brief invisibility, and grants an increased health recovery with her ability. It gives a passive increase to max health. The Action Figure summons a Giant Giant to fight by the Archer Queen's side. It gives a passive increase to damage and max health and grants her self healing. The Monolith Arrow passively makes her attacks deal bonus damage based off the target's maximum health. This bonus damage decreases the more troops are deployed. it also gives a passive hitpoint increase and grants damage reduction. Strategies Offensive Strategies The six Home Village Heroes serve different roles in raids. The Barbarian King is the strength specialist, the Minion Prince is the air specialist, the Archer Queen is the speed specialist, the Grand Warden is the support specialist, the Royal Champion is the offense specialist, and the Dragon Duke is the solo specialist. Deploy her behind the Barbarian King as he tanks and deals the damage while the Archer Queen does necessary damage in order to destroy certain defenses by her speed. She has a better range than an Archer (5 tiles instead of 3.5), so a good strategy is to place a group of Giants , P.E.K.K.As , Golems , or the Barbarian King as a meat shield, then a group of Archers, and finally the Archer Queen. This minimizes the chance of her being defeated or even hit and may allow you to use her many times in a row without waiting for her to regenerate. The Archer Queen and Healer combination, better known as Queen Walk, is a very viable strategy when you are targeting for loot. She can clear large areas of the base, creating an effective funnel. This, however, requires a high-level Queen due to the fact that the Queen alone cannot deal enough damage and will eventually run out of time. Air Defenses bombing the Healers can easily destroy this, but this does not happen very often since the Archer Queen's range and the Healer's range allow the Healers to stay out of most Air Defenses' range. A related version of the Queen Walk is the Queen Charge, where instead of being used for funneling, the Queen and Healers target the core of the base, destroying key defenses. This usually involves the use of Wall Breakers , their super form , or Jump Spells in addition to other funneling troops (such as Baby Dragons ) to ensure she enters the base, and then using her abilities to wipe defenses. An alternate version of the Queen Walk that can be utilized is with Druids instead of Healers. Unlike Healers, Druids do not have a reduced healing rate when healing Heroes, making them slightly more effective. In addition, their healing bounces from one troop or Hero to another, thereby giving you the ability to add supporting troops in a Queen Walk. The downside to using Druids instead of Healers is that they will only remain in their base form for 30 seconds before transforming into their Bear form. Once they have turned into a Bear, they can no longer heal the Queen and/or troops and instead target defenses, which can sometimes be useful to tank the Queen from incoming defenses. For Queen Walks and Charges, Rage Spells can be used to boost both the Archer Queen and the Healers/Druids if needed. When boosted by Rage Spells, the Healers/Druids will heal faster, allowing them to heal the Queen quickly if she should take lots of damage. Freeze Spells are also handy to have to stop high-damage defenses like the single-target Inferno Tower , while the Overgrowth Spell can divert the Queen and prevent her from taking damage. Seeking Air Mines can also counter this. Periodically place some Balloons near the Healers to try and soak them up. These Balloons are often called "coco loons". Try to bring about 3 or 4. Any extra ones may also be used like normal Balloons. However, the Seeking Air Mine strategy does not work on Druids, since they are ground units and will not trigger these aerial traps in any way, at the cost of being vulnerable to defenses and traps that target ground units. The Unicorn can be used in place of a Healer or Druid. However, in a lot of strategies, you see them both used at the same time for maximum healing to the Archer Queen, which increases her sustainability. The Invisibility Vial , when equipped, prevents defenses from targeting the Archer Queen, but she can be affected by splash damage; for instance, if nearby troops are targeted by a Mortar or a Scattershot , the splash projectile of the Mortar and the Scattershot will damage the Archer Queen if she is in range, regardless of whether her ability is active or not. The Invisibility Vial does not prevent the Archer Queen from triggering Bombs and Giant Bombs and she will still be damaged by them if she is in range when they explode. The activated Invisibility Vial's ability is excellent against single-target Inferno Towers. When used, the Inferno Tower's damage will not only reset, but is often redirected onto a summoned Archer if the Archer Puppet is equipped. The Queen can quickly finish off the Inferno with her damage under the cloak, while the Archers can provide great cover and overwhelm the Inferno if it is not defended well by splash defenses (or other multi-targeting Infernos). Without the Archer Puppet, her sustainability will increased significantly, especially if the Invisibility Vial is paired with either the Giant Arrow or Frozen Arrow. The Invisibility Vial ability will also not prevent any projectiles (such as Cannon shots) that are targeting the Archer Queen at the time of the ability's activation from hitting her. If the Eagle Artillery has already locked on and fired on the Queen, activating the Invisibility Vial will not prevent the shots from hitting, which will result in great damage against your Queen. Activating the ability just before it fires will stop the Eagle Artillery from firing on your Archer Queen, however, and render the Queen temporarily untargetable by the Eagle Artillery as normal. A good idea is to put the Archer Queen with the other heroes. The Barbarian King soaks up hits, the Archer Queen attacks from behind, the Grand Warden supports them with his Life Gem or the Rage Gem , and the Royal Champion destroys defenses. If there are troops in the Clan Castle , they also get benefits from the Grand Warden and they can assist the other heroes in terms of defending and stalling. This is also called a hero dive, where you push a certain amount of your heroes into the base a little. This can help with funneling, take out major defenses or just getting percentage in general. Sending the Archer Queen and any other heroes like this with little support (up to about 25 housing space of troops) is known as a Sui Queen. This is best used to destroy outer portions of the base and a few key targets farther in. Beware of the Barbarian King, as he can knock out the Archer Queen in a 1v1 if they are at the same level or if the Archer Queen is only 5 levels or lower than the King. If you are going to 1v1 the Barbarian King, place Healers/Druids to support the Queen or place Wizards or any other high-damaging troop to quickly defeat the King. Headhunters, if you have access, is also good when going against the King. The Invisibility Vial ability's mechanism will cause her to be considered as a new target different from the original Archer Queen. Against a defending Electro Dragon , this ability may backfire, as it may cause her to take two hits from the Electro Dragon's Chain Lightning ability. If you do not need to use her ability during battle, you do not always need to. If the battle ends and she does not use her ability, after battle she will recover health equal to the ability recovery. By far and away the most common Pet to pair with the Archer Queen is Frosty can also be used for Queen Walks and smash-style attacks, slowing down defenses and distracting them with his Frostmites . Alternatively, the Unicorn can be used as it enables her to be healed over time, greatly increasing her sustainability. The Phoenix , when unlocked, can substitute for the Unicorn if the latter is being upgraded, being able to extend the lifetime of the Queen and allowing her to do extra damage before she goes down. Diggy can stun defenses and units to allow the Archer Queen more time to deal with them, but only works on a single target. The Phoenix can also revive the Archer Queen if she happens to be defeated while under her ability. The subsequent revival allows the Queen to use most of, if not the full duration of her extremely damaging ability if the Invisibility Vial is active. The Archer Queen benefits from having higher-level equipment, so leveling up your equipment will greatly improve the Archer Queen. A good Hero Equipment combination for the Archer Queen includes the Frozen Arrow and Invisibility Vial, as this reduces her incoming damage by slowing down defenses, and making her invisible allows her to deal more damage. However, if you are using a pet, the Pet will not turn invisible, forcing the pet to get taken down early, which can leave the Queen without support. Other good combos include the Frozen Arrow and Healer Puppet, which allows her more healers for extra health recovery, and also self-heals over time. The Invisibility Vial and Healer Puppet for guaranteed healing, and the Giant Arrow and Invisibility Vial or the Magic Mirror for ZapQuake attacks are all good combinations to a certain extent. Some good Hero Equipment pairings include: The Frozen Arrow and Invisibility Vial, which allows the Queen to provides some support on slowing the defenses and survive and do more damage when necessary. The Magic Mirror is usually an upgrade to the Invisibility Vial in most situations. The Magic Mirror summons clones and turns the Queen invisible briefly so defenses will target them instead, they do more extra damage overall and have some tanking capability, it also provides more maximum health passively and have extra health recovery to make up for not being invisible for longer. Pairing this with the Action Figure allows the Giant Giant to tank for all the cloned Queens, allowing the Queens to deal significant amounts of damage when both abilities are activated. The Healer Puppet and Giant Arrow/Frozen Arrow/Archer Puppet, as both abilities can be used immediately with little to no conflicts, unlike Invisibility Vial or Magic Mirror. The Healer Puppet and Invisibility Vial/Magic Mirror are still a valid pairing, as the passive healing already helps the Queen's sustainability in the core, having invisibility time and retargeting available with extra Healers being spawned can be an insurance. Defensive Strategies The Archer Queen is more suitable for defense than the Barbarian King because of her higher damage per second, and she is able to attack from a longer range (as well as being able to strike air units ), but she has dramatically lower health than the Barbarian King. The Hero Banner must be placed 3-4 spaces from the nearest wall to prevent the Queen from jumping out and getting targeted by melee troops. Protect your key defenses by keeping them more than 5 tiles away from the nearest open space, so the Queen cannot snipe them. Keep your Eagle Artillery away from the Queen's banner so that the opponent cannot destroy both with Electrone or Blizzard. The best strategy against an Archer Queen is often another Archer Queen. A Queen Walk or an Archer Queen behind a tank troop can take down an enemy Queen quickly, especially if her Equipment abilities are activated. Tanking troops can be of some use, but they will not last long against an Archer Queen. For example, a maxed Golem will last only 10-11 seconds against a max-level Archer Queen, not accounting for any other defenses that may be targeting it. If you are using a similar level, using the Barbarian King as a tank and the enemy Archer Queen is not hiding behind a wall, then the Barbarian King himself will be sufficient to defeat the Queen unless nearby defenses or the defending Clan Castle troops or Barbarian King are also attacking him. Activating the King's ability will allow him to defeat the Queen quicker. If the Archer Queen is near the edge of the base, you can use a Barbarian King to take it out. You might need to use the King's ability if he is low-leveled. Consider bringing a spell or spells to make the takedown process easier, such as a Poison Spell to slow the Queen's attacks, a Skeleton Spell to distract her, or a Freeze Spell to keep her from killing your troops too quickly. The Grand Warden 's Eternal Tome ability can keep troops alive while they destroy an Archer Queen. Because the Queen's health is so low, the short duration of the Eternal Tome ability is rarely a problem. You can defeat the defending Archer Queen with high-leveled Lightning Spells if she is low leveled. However, this is not a recommended strategy because you cannot easily guarantee that she will die if you bring too little. Even against higher-level Archer Queens, the strategy can still be useful if you are bringing enough Lightning Spells to destroy other key buildings alongside taking her out (such as the Eagle Artillery ), usually with the help of Earthquake Spells to help destroy defenses. Like with the Barbarian King or the Royal Champion, Headhunters are effective at targeting and attacking the Archer Queen, and they are used in small numbers in most high-level strategies such as LavaLoon where the other troops cannot target or damage her effectively. However, if Headhunters are sent in alone without assistance or not being protected by the Grand Warden's Eternal Tome ability, they will likely be picked off and taken out easily by the Queen or nearby defenses. As such, they are best sneaked in, covered by other attacking troops or by the Grand Warden's Eternal Tome ability. Standard and Legendary denotes skins not available from the Gold Pass that were available only through a special offer or event. Key for highlighted entries: Entries that are highlighted denote that the skin is available in the current Season Challenges season. Entries marked with a Coathanger denote a Standard or Legendary skin that is permanently available for re-purchase in the cosmetics tab at the original price when the skin was originally offered. Entries marked with a Gem denote that the skin is purchasable with Gems; all skins currently purchasable in this manner cost 1,500 . Entries marked with a Yellow Star denote that the skin is exclusive; these skins will not be available for re-purchase in the future. Notes If you tap on the Archer Queen, she will yell a high pitched battle cry and stand still for a moment, similar to the Barbarian King . Her default skin will wave a hand towards the player. If she is wearing her Gladiator or Champion skin, she will instead bow down towards the player. If she is in her Valkyrie Queen skin, she will raise her modified X-Bow and stand tall. The Autumn Queen skin will spin counter-clockwise, with a bow in hand. If she is wearing the Ice Queen skin, she will pull her hand up to her face. If she is wearing the Warrior Queen skin, she will bow down to the user. If she is wearing the Primal Queen skin, she will put her hand on her costume and look up. If she is wearing the Clockwork Queen skin, she will load and fire her crossbow. If she is wearing the Pirate Queen skin, she will be waving at the player. If she is wearing the Rogue Queen skin, she will wave toward the player in a very similar way to the original skin. If she is wearing the Jungle Queen skin, she will bow down to the left side. If she is wearing the Party Queen skin, she will clench her right fist and lift it to the player. If she is wearing the Kyudo Queen skin, she will bow to the player. If she is wearing the Queen Fatale skin, she will position herself in a seductive pose and kiss to the player. If she is wearing the Renegade Queen skin, she will spray tag a logo on the ground. If she is wearing the Clash-A-Rama Queen skin, she will show off her X-Bow to the player before accidentally launching an arrow into the distance. If she is wearing the P.E.Q.Q.A skin, a butterfly will appear on her head and she will become enticed by it. Shortly after, the insect disappears. If she is wearing the Archer Hunter skin, she will take a skull out, toss it upwards into the air and swing it like a baseball bat with her X-Bow. If she is wearing the Fury Queen skin, she will somersault into the air and fire from her X-Bow before landing back on the ground. If she is wearing the Blizzard Queen skin, she will create a snowflake in her left hand, smile at the player and fire an arrow at it as it levitates into the air. If she is wearing the Queen of the Dunes skin, the monkey driving her cart will be spooked and run around wildly, almost causing the Queen to fall out of it. All Archer Queen skins are left-handed. Some of the Archer Queen skins have some unique features that other skins from the Archer Queen do not have. The Warrior Queen skin has unique pink colored particles after she is deployed. The Ice Queen skin has unique ice-like particles when her ability is activated. When you tap the Archer Queen while she is wearing her Clockwork skin, she fires a single arrow. However, while attacking in battles se fires three. When deployed, the Champion Queen will have a fiery ring where she is placed, which lasts for one second. The Clash-A-Rama Queen skin's X-Bow causes small explosions to appear wherever her arrows land. Some of the Archer Queen's skins feature her holding different weapons instead of her X-Bow: With the Champion Queen, Magic Queen, Queen of the North, Egypt Queen, Clash Games Queen, Archer Satyr, Fire Queen, Quickfire Queen, Kyudo Queen and Blizzard Queen skins, the Archer Queen holds a recurve bow instead of an X-Bow. In the case of the Kyudo Queen, she uses a yumi , a Japanese asymmetrical bow. With the Space Queen skin, her X-Bow is replaced with a large gun with a satellite dish. With the Wild West Queen skin, she uses two revolvers. With the Football Queen skin, the Archer Queen uses a football instead of an X-Bow. With the Summer Queen skin, she uses a large gun with a parasol at the end of its barrel. With the Dark Minion Queen skin, she uses a crossbow with a green blade attached to one of her arms. With the Puppet Queen skin, she uses a firework launcher toy. With the Snake Queen skin, she holds an umbrella and attacks by launching water at the target. With the Brutality Queen skin, she throws a chair at the target. With the Queen Fatale skin, she uses a Thompson submachine gun . With the Renegade Queen skin, she uses a plasma X-Bow. With the P.E.Q.Q.A skin, her X-Bow has been combined with a P.E.K.K.A 's sword. With the Queen of the Dunes skin, she uses sand as her weapon of choice and fires arrows molded from said substance. Before skins and 3D models were added, the Archer Queen used to have recoil when she attacked. A clip of this can be seen here . Before the Archer Queen's texture was converted into a 3D model, she had visual changes at levels 10, 20, and 41. Initially, the Archer Queen is similar to a giant Archer , but with a modified X-Bow , a silver crown, purple hair, and a darker green tunic. At level 10, her crown became golden. At level 20, the stock of her modified X-Bow became golden as well. Her shots used to change from Elixir-colored to gold. At level 41, her cloak received a golden rim, and her golden modified X-Bow stock became a darker gold color or gained a purple glow outline. Levels 1-9 (Old Sprite) Levels 10-19 (Old Sprite) Levels 20-40 (Old Sprite) Levels 41-60 (Old Sprite) Trivia If the Archer Queen attacks while her Invisibility Vial ability is active, her arrows change from their normal Elixir-like color to bright orange. When she is injured or falls in battle, a small explosion occurs, she yells in pain, and a red beam shoots to the sky. After that, like all other heroes, the Archer Queen stands still and a "dizzy" animation is engaged. However, this only applies to certain Hero Skins for the Archer Queen, and her knockout sounds may be different. Sometimes the Archer Queen attacks a wall but then may seemingly retarget and attack another wall; this is most often caused by her retargeting to a different target (usually because her previous target was destroyed). While attacking, if the opponent's Hero Banner is empty and the Archer Queen wakes up during the battle, the Hero Banner will have a short sparkling animation but the Archer Queen will not appear to defend the base. If your Archer Queen wakes up while you are in Village Edit Mode , a sparkle will appear wherever in the Hero Banner's original location (even if you moved it already). However, as of the March 27, 2025 update, this no longer occurs. A maximum level Electro Dragon under a maximum-level Rage Spell can one-shot a level 1-78 Archer Queen, but a level 79 or 80 Archer Queen survives. A level 79 Archer Queen survives with exactly 2 hitpoints left. However, as of the latest update, a level 4 Electro Dragon can one-shot a defending Archer Queen even at level 95, due to defending Heroes not equipping Hero Equipment on defense. Prior to the January 29, 2014 update that introduced Hero abilities, and prior to the October 12, 2020 update that removed the sleep button for Heroes, the original description for the Archer Queen, as well as the Barbarian King , were " Heroes can attack enemy villages or guard your village. Heroes can be injured, but are immortal. Heal them by letting them sleep or using the Heal button. Heroes won't defend the village while sleeping ." When initially released, the Archer Queen cost 40,000 Dark Elixir to summon. This was later reduced to 20,000 in the March 2020 update, and further reduced to 10,000 in the April 2021 update. Today, Archer Queen cost 1,600,000 Elixir to summon via upgrading Hero Hall to level 2 at Town Hall 8 in the November 2024 Update. The first person to max out the Archer Queen and Barbarian King was a player named jessiebrar (during the initial release of Heroes , the max level for both Heroes was 30). The Archer Queen appears with long wristbands in her artwork, but does not appear with them in battle. She used to appear with long wristbands in her 2D sprite before being converted into 3D. The Archer Queen's crossbow fires out three arrows, despite that it is designed to only be loaded with a single arrow. The Archer Queen one of two Heroes to appear in Clash Royale , the other being the Grand Warden . The Archer Queen's Royal Cloak ability in Clash of Clans functions similarly to the Cloaking Cape in Clash Royale . In addition to its Clash Royale effects, it partially heals the Archer Queen and summons Archers when used in Clash of Clans . Unlike the Archer Queen in Clash of Clans , the Archer Queen in Clash Royale is not enormous. She is not immortal either, as she turns into Elixir when she dies. The Archer Queen is one of two Heroes to appear as a character in Squad Busters , the other being the Barbarian King. The "Town Hall 16" update, released on December 12, 2023, reduced the Archer Queen's hitpoints and damage by around 20% each and changed the Royal Cloak ability to be split into 2 parts, the Archer Puppet and Invisibility Vial. This was done to make Heroes weaker on defense. Her description was also changed. It used to read " This graceful huntress is a master of destructive force, though modest in health. She snipes targets in her territory when defending, and can summon stealth and terrifying damage when attacking once her Royal Cloak ability is unlocked! ". Despite the March 27, 2025 maintenance break that removed training times in the Home Village, the "regeneration time" statistic is still visible in Hero info screens, although it does not have an effect on gameplay, and was later fixed afterwards. [please specify which update] The regeneration time used to start at 10 minutes and increases by 2 minutes at every 5th level to a maximum of 48 minutes at level 95 onwards. Comparisons The Archer Queen is one of the three units that can attack an Air Defense while being healed by a Healer without the Healer being in range of the aforementioned Air Defense. The other four units capable of doing this are the Grand Warden , Apprentice Warden (if alone), Thrower , and the Super Archer . The Archer Queen is the only human Hero to appear barefoot in her default skin. The Archer Queen is one of the three units associated with Archers , the others being the Sneaky Archer and Super Archer . The Archer Queen is one of the 13 units to appear in a Scenery, the others being the Barbarian , Goblin , Balloon , Hog Rider , Barbarian King , P.E.K.K.A , Baby Dragon , Skeleton , Grand Warden, Dragon Rider , Cannon Cart , and the Party Wizard . In her case, she appears in the Clashy Constructs (as Clockwork Queen), and the 9th Clashiversary Scenery (as Party Queen). The Archer Queen and the Barbarian King were the first Heroes added to the game, and both have the highest levels out of any unit in the game. They also appear as characters in Squad Busters . If the Archer Queen equips a max level Magic Mirror and Archer Puppet, her health recovery increases to 1790. However, if she equips a max level Archer Puppet and a max level Frozen Arrow, she does 1,107 DPS which is more than all four maxed supercharged X-Bows at Town Hall 17 which collectively do 980 DPS. The Archer Queen deals the third highest damage out of all the Heroes, however, in case of DPS, her Damage per Second is the highest out of them in that matter, including most of the troops . The Archer Queen was originally unlocked at Town Hall 9 until the Town Hall 17 update on November 25, 2024, it was lowered by 1 and is now available for Town Hall 8 players. After her transition to being unlocked at Town Hall 8, she is also the only Hero to be unlocked at a Town Hall level of an even number, as opposed to other Heroes, which are unlocked at odd levels starting from Town Hall 7 up to 13.
